title: Systems Data Analyst
description:
After clicking Apply, you'll be invited to create a profile on the Via website to complete your application. This doesn't guarantee you'll be matched to this specific role - Via reviews every application (AI first, then a human checks the fit) and shortlists the right candidates. Your profile also stays active for other relevant roles on the platform, and stays anonymous until you match. It takes just a few minutes.

Salary: £40,000–£80,000 per year (DOE)

Location: London, WC2B 6SR

Working arrangement: Hybrid – minimum 2 days per week in the office

About the opportunity

Via is partnering with a leading UK homeware retailer looking for a Systems Data Analyst to support its enterprise data platform.

You'll analyse business systems, map data flows and translate requirements into clear data models and specifications to improve data quality and integration.

What you'll be doing
  • Analyse source systems, integrations and end-to-end data flows
  • Develop conceptual, logical and physical data models
  • Define data requirements and source-to-target mappings
  • Identify data quality issues, risks and inconsistencies
  • Use SQL to investigate and validate data
  • Document business processes, system requirements and data structures
What we're looking for
  • 3+ years' experience in systems analysis, data analysis or data modelling
  • Strong SQL skills and exposure to Python
  • Experience producing data models and technical documentation
  • Understanding of enterprise data platforms and system integrations
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills

Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, retail systems (ERP, POS or supply chain) or Agile delivery would be advantageous.

Why apply?
  • £40,000–£80,000 annual salary
  • Hybrid working
  • Discretionary bonus
  • Share scheme
  • Pension scheme
  • Private healthcare
  • Opportunity to support enterprise-scale data transformation
